title: Sequencer Follow-On Mismatch
claim: FP-MCP-311 confirmed the sequencer and clearance preview worked, then recorded that the wrong follow-on tool was selected. The wrong call refused and made no usable artifact.
summary: The sequencer returned PREVIEW_CLEARANCE for FP-MCP-295 with FP-MCP-310 approval. The returned clearance preview tool was called and passed. The intended follow-on was clearance creation, but scoped enablement creation was selected instead. It refused with CLEARANCE_VALID_FAILED and CLEARANCE_ID_MATCHES_FAILED. No approval was consumed and no canary ran.
caveats: Continuation must start from the sequencer again.
observedResult: FP-MCP-311 confirmed the sequencer and clearance preview worked, then recorded that the wrong follow-on tool was selected. The wrong call refused and made no usable artifact.
